chairman.name: Prof. Dr. Shafiqur Rahman
message: Welcome to the Department of Law at Port City International University. Our department is committed to producing competent legal professionals who uphold justice, integrity, and the rule of law.

The legal profession plays a vital role in maintaining social order and protecting individual rights. Our comprehensive curriculum covers constitutional law, criminal law, civil law, corporate law, and international law, preparing students for diverse careers in the legal field.

With experienced faculty members who combine academic excellence with practical legal experience, we provide students with both theoretical knowledge and practical skills necessary for success in the legal profession.

content: The Department of Law at PCIU is dedicated to producing skilled legal professionals. Our curriculum covers constitutional law, criminal law, civil law, corporate law, and international law.
